item.title: Gold Logs Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
item.description: Gold slid for a fifth day — notching its biggest weekly decline since March — as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a rout in AI stocks spurred selling across metals markets.

item.title: Fear and ‘Hot Sauce’: Young Investors Want To Catch Up
item.description: Buzzy stocks, leveraged ETFs, and a generation feeling left behind. BlackRock’s Gargi Chaudhuri discusses ways investors can dabble in risky products while also leaning into time-proven strategies. On this week’s “Bloomberg Money”, she joins Tom Keene and Scarlet Fu, who gives a shoutout to @Eric Balchunas and his coverage of ‘hot sauce’ investment products. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Fiber Network Operator Zayo Delays Public ABS Sale Until 2027
item.description: Fiber-optic network operator Zayo Group Holdings Inc. is delaying the public-market leg of a planned asset-backed securities offering, while moving ahead with the privately placed portion, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

item.title: CrowdStrike Said in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
item.description: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector. Zscaler, which had a market value of $32 billion at the end of regular trading Friday, rose about 16% after the close. The two companies are discussing a potential combination that could come together soon, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is confidential. Bloomberg News Deals Reporter Ryan Gould reports on the deal. (Source: Bloomberg)
